Let me start with the part that made me laugh, because you should know which part that was. Your page says work and standing reads hard. Then, under the heading where you promise me the things only a small minority of charts say - the place where you actually stick your neck out - you say the chart is unusually negative about work and standing. So you said it twice. You committed. And I am the best-selling female recording artist in history, I have sold something over 300 million records, I have the highest-grossing tour ever done by a woman, I went into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2008 in my first year of eligibility, and I have been famous continuously since 1984. If a method is unusually negative about my standing, that method is not measuring me. It is measuring something, but it is not me.

The same page tells me the chart is unusually negative about income, gains and friends. Two paragraphs later, under 'Matters that read well', the first thing after home and children is: income, gains and friends. You have written both. That is not nuance. That is a hedge with the seams showing. And on the facts I am worth somewhere near 850 million dollars, I own my catalogue, I negotiated a 60 million dollar deal in 1992 when women in this business were negotiating for a car, and I have never carried debt. So even your hedge only has one true side.

Now the places you were right, and I will give them to you honestly. Marriage and partnerships read hard - yes. Two marriages, two divorces, and I wrote Guy a check for something in the region of 76 million dollars in 2008. Brothers and sisters read hard - yes, and this is the one that lands. Anthony drank himself out of the family and slept under a bridge in Michigan and died in February 2023. Christopher wrote a book about me in 2008 and I did not speak to him for years, and then he got cancer and we found our way back and he died in October 2024. Health and energy read hard - I was intubated in an ICU in June of 2023 and my first word coming out of four days of induced coma was no. Home, property and mother read well and I would fight you on the mother half; mine died of breast cancer on December first, 1963, when I was five, and there is nothing well-reading about that. Property, fine. I have bought a lot of houses.

The temperament line - quick-minded, talkative, at home with words, numbers and dealing. It is true. It is also true of every person who has ever been good at anything commercial, and you could hand that sentence to my accountant, my lawyer and my publicist and get three nods.

Courage reads hard. I built a career on doing the thing everyone said would end it - the crucifix, the Sex book in 1992, Pepsi pulling the ad in 1989, standing on that stage at 66 with no cartilage in my knee. Whatever the chart is calling courage, it is not the thing I have.

And the empty headings. What reads well, what reads hard, mixed, right now - four of them with nothing under them at all, then the same information further down as bullet lists. If I shipped a show with four empty numbers in it I would not be here.

What is missing is the two years I have actually just lived. You say right now reads a strong stretch and lists seven matters as live. Since the middle of 2023 I nearly died, I lost my brother Anthony, I lost Joan in September of 2024, I lost Christopher three weeks later, and I stood up and did 80 shows anyway and finished on a beach in Rio in front of a million and a half people. Not one line of that is on your page in either direction. You cannot tell me it was a strong stretch and also not know a single thing that happened in it.

notes: Answered as Madonna Louise Ciccone (b. 16 Aug 1958, 07:05, old Mercy Hospital, Bay City MI; birth time Rodden A from the hospital record via Marcie Noonan / Bay-Journal, hence A1=hospital, A2=to_5, A3=no), from the documented record, having read the short reading first. Where the reading and the life conflicted the life won. (1) The reading's single boldest claim - that it is 'unusually negative about income, gains and friends, short trips and local travel and work and standing' - is contradicted by the record on both money and standing (~$850M net worth, the 1992 $60M Maverick/Time Warner deal, highest-grossing tour by a female artist, RRHOF 2008, best-selling female recording artist), so C7=opt2 and A19=about_right and I logged plain_reading+houses as plainly wrong in D1. The reading also self-contradicts: 'income, gains and friends' appears simultaneously under 'reads well' and under 'unusually negative'. (2) Contamination pull noted and resisted where the record allowed: the reading calls 'children and learning' favourable and I did answer C9=opt2, but only at confidence 3, because the record genuinely cuts both ways - six children, all living and now close, against the Dec 2015-Jun 2016 Rocco custody litigation she has called the most painful experience of her life and during which she said she contemplated suicide, plus the contested Malawi adoptions (David Banda 2006, Mercy James granted on appeal 12 Jun 2009). This is the one answer where the reading and my answer agree and I want that flagged rather than hidden. (3) Where the reading was right it was right on things a coin toss also gets: marriage hard (Penn 1985-89, Ritchie 2000-08, ~$76-92M settlement) = C2=opt1 conf 5; siblings hard (Anthony d. Feb 2023 after alcoholism and homelessness; Christopher's 2008 memoir and estrangement, d. 4 Oct 2024) = C1=opt1 conf 4 and A13=lost; health hard (June 2023 bacterial infection, intubated, several days ICU; hip replacement confirmed 2021; 'no cartilage' in one knee; 2005 horse fall with three cracked ribs, broken collarbone and broken hand) = A4=four_plus, A5=two_plus, A6=joints+nerves. Judgement calls and thin spots: A6 'joints' is well documented, 'nerves' is inferred from her own accounts of sleep and anxiety around the custody period and is the weakest item here. A7 'average' and A8 'no' - childhood health is essentially undocumented either way. A9 'mixed' - only Elsie Mae Fortin (1911-2011, d. at 99) is firmly documented; the paternal grandparents' spans are not. A10 'conflicted' rather than 'distant' for Silvio Ciccone (still living, 95): the documented teenage record is open rebellion and her anger at his 1966 remarriage to Joan Gustafson, though they reconciled decades ago - 'distant' was the near miss. A11 'steady' - Chrysler/General Dynamics engineer, middle-class Pontiac then Rochester Hills, no documented reversal. A21 'net_gain' rests on the Vita Coco stake (~$1.5M in 2010, company later public) and her art holdings; Maverick's reported $66M of losses to 1999 and the 2016-19 collapse of Hard Candy Fitness are business failures rather than speculation, and are logged at A35 2004-06 as money_loss. A22/A23 'none' - no documented inheritance or debt. A31 'extended' is her own statement about the 2016 custody period; no treatment is documented, so this may be over-strong. A26 'on_time' at 27 is a guess about family pattern. B2 'lean_short' for 5'4" and famously lean - 'medium' was arguable. C6 eyesight at confidence 2 is answered from the absence of any documented eye trouble, not from positive evidence; C11 vehicles likewise at confidence 2 (her documented accidents are horses and stages, not conveyances). C12=opt1 on the strength of serial reinvention being the single most-cited fact about her career. A35 omits the hip replacement because the surgery date is not firmly reported (confirmed by her in 2021); 1978:other and 1992-10:other are the NYC rape she described in Harper's Bazaar and the Sex book, neither of which has a clean event code. D2 is empty: the only claims in this reading that could not have been guessed about anyone are the two 'unusual for this chart' ones, and both are wrong. D4 lists the eight chapters this short reading does not contain.
